why: Website gallery CD03 Scene 40 (dusk, high view straight down the Water Lagoon between the wings: the pod pavilion, islands, a separate pool bottom-left). The pools_all 'Water Lagoon' row: the one picture that shows how long the lagoon runs (155 m). 4:3 crop; no people, no baked text. Not Scene 58 on purpose: masterplan_lagoon (the row's tap) already uses it.

Owner's UE model, top view of the site (SiteEnvironment, UI collapsed). Crop = the west courtyard with the printed BUILDING E / F / D labels, where the landscape plan puts the labelled Private Pools (beside the E wing, under F; report 12.3). Drops the UE control buttons and the room walls of the viewer. The pools_all 'Private Pools' row: shows where they are, does not point at one pool.

Website gallery Playscape Scene 55 (aerial): the space-dome playground, the polished sculpture slide into the pool and the ring of the Kid's Pool beside it (report 9.9 / 12.10: Kid's Pool next to the Playscape). Crop starts right of x=700 and below y=630 so the small figures on the path and at the Junior World door are out of the picture. Used by pools_all and for_families.

Website gallery Playscape Scene 50 (eye level): the 'Space Playground' dome on legs, the steel tube slide, the planet-pattern floor (report 9.9). for_families 'Space Playground' row. No people, no text; 3:2 crop.

Approved slide intro-011 'THE PARK' (deck p.11): dusk view across the park lake with the low-rise blocks behind. Crop keeps the lake and trees and drops the slide title, the logo and the bottom-right badge (owner forbids that wording on screen). The developer's illustration of the park next door, not a photo of it: the card says 'The Park' (the deck's word) and names the real park in its small line.
Website gallery CD03 Scene 43: a paved path between dense shrub beds, trees and the lagoon. park_green 'Green area' card (Softscape 4,256 sq.m.). 16:10 crop for the features card; no people.
Website gallery CD03 Scene 38: large shade trees, a white-flowering tree, shrub beds along the lagoon. park_green '34 plant species' card. 16:10 crop; no people.

Website gallery CD03 Scene 37: stepped lawn terraces with white daybeds under the mirror-steel canopies, pool behind (report 12.11: Stepped Garden, daybeds). park_green 'Stepped Garden' card. 16:10 crop; no people.

Website gallery CD03 Scene 58 (daylight, high view down the Water Lagoon): several of its islands with trees, the shell-shaped pavilion island, the glass bridges. 16:9 so the number sits under the picture. Base of lagoon_islands (owner 14 Oct: the islands question had no motion).
